description.text:
Overview:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative CRM Specialist to own the administration, optimization, and data integrity of our commercial CRM ecosystem.
In this role, you will serve as the core technical administrator while partnering with regional teams and external vendors to drive continuous platform enhancements. Beyond system configuration and managing critical customer master data (HCP/HCO), you will act as a vital enablement partner for our frontline sales teams-delivering the training and support necessary to maximize platform adoption and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities:
• CRM Platform Administration & Configuration: Act as the primary system administrator for the CRM platform. Manage user permissions, configure custom workflows, maintain page layouts, and troubleshoot day-to-day technical issues to ensure high system availability and seamless operational continuity.
• Platform Optimization & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with regional commercial/IT teams and external technology vendors to identify, design, and deploy system enhancements. Translate local business requirements into functional specifications, managing the rollout and testing of new features, localization modules, and system upgrades.
• HCP/HCO Master Data Management: Oversee the governance, hygiene, and integrity of the Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organization (HCO) master databases. Manage the Data Change Request (DCR) process, audit customer records for accuracy, and ensure strict data compliance standards are maintained to support precise target segmentation.
• Sales Force Enablement & Training: Design, update, and deliver comprehensive CRM platform training programs and user documentation for the field force and sales teams. Onboard new commercial hires, educate existing users on system updates, and champion best practices to drive high user adoption and data entry quality.

key_values.text: 客戶資料更新維護、資料庫系統管理維護、系統導入、員工教育訓練與需求分析、專案溝通╱整合管理、供應商資料管理維護、專案管理軟體操作

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Requirements & Qualifications:
• Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in CRM system administration, sales operations, or commercial excellence, ideally within a regulated market or structured enterprise environment.
• CRM Platform Expertise: Proven track record administering enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Veeva CRM, or IQVIA OCE). Relevant platform certifications are highly regarded.
• Master Data & Governance Skills: Solid understanding of relational databases and experience managing customer master data management (MDM) workflows, data cleaning, and data quality assurance.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong experience working with external technology vendors and collaborating with matrixed or regional teams across different geographies
• Communication & Training Capability: Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to translate technical system functionalities into clear, practical training modules for non-technical sales representatives.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
